environmental.surge-protection: differential mode 2 kV, common mode 6 kV

features.layer: L2+ (static routing, ERPS ring recovery 20 ms or less)
features.optics-sfp: vendor optics listed under AurCore Accessories - AOM01M-S550 (1G, multimode, 550 m) and AOM01S-K10 (1G, single-mode, 10 km); the datasheet states no compatibility list or third-party policy

management.interfaces: console, Telnet, SSH, SNMP v1/v2c/v3, web, ACC/ACN cloud

physical.accessories: two pluggable terminal plugs (power and relay), console cable
physical.dimensions-in: 4.33 x 3.66 x 2.84 (L x W x H, datasheet)

configs.description: AIS2001P industrial switch, 4x GbE PoE+ and 2x GbE SFP, L2+, dual 48-57 V DC
configs.name: base

gaps.wanted: A dimensioned drawing or the in-box quick installation guide. Nothing published gives the bevels, the DIN clip's position or the top-face layout; they are photo-measured or estimated (see provenance). AurCore support or a reseller holds the guide.
The unit's weight; the datasheet gives none.
A lamped RJ45 cell with about 11 mm between its lamps on an 11 mm column; the library's nearest puts them 8.3 mm apart.

`attrs.platform.cpu`; one of `operating-temp`, `operating-temp-f2b`, `operating-temp-b2f` in `attrs.environmental` (profile `networking` - see spec/schemas/profiles.yaml) - unlocks the About panel, and comparison against other devices
`physical-context` on port groups gbe-poe, sfp - unlocks ENTITY-MIB / Redfish correlation and monitoring overlays

bevel.note: photo-measured - the small housing has the large one's octagonal section at its own size. The front's silhouette narrows about 9 mm at its top and bottom rows and reaches full width about 15-16 mm in, at every corner, so the four depth-wise edges are bevelled [9, 16] (the image's mask quantises to 1.8 mm). The legend plate is 44.5 of the 72.1 mm face, so the edges where the front and back meet the finned sides are bevelled 13.8, taken at 45 degrees as on the large housing, whose video shows the same bands.

bottom-layout.note: estimated - not photographed; drawn bare (see the underside gap).

chassis.note: datasheet - 'Dimension (L*W*H) 4.33 x 3.66 x 2.84 in'. As on the large housing the letters are not width, height and depth: the straight-on front reads within 2.5 percent of 2.84/4.33 = 0.656 wide-to-tall, so L (110.0 mm) is the face's height as the unit hangs on the rail, H (72.1) its width and W (93.0) the depth.

front-layout.note: photo-measured on the straight-on AIS2001P front image at 4.427 px/mm from the datasheet's 110 mm face height (Gate 1: the face's own width agrees to 1-2.5 percent). Lamps located by colour: the control row at y 8.6 (PWR 27.5, SYS 32.6, the SFP lamps 5 and 6 at 37.7 and 42.75); jack lamps in columns at x 26.6 and 48.3, rows on a 15.77 mm pitch from y 24.4; the SFP pair x 25.0-50.0, y 87.6-102.1, between two gold number strips. Jacks are drawn with the lamped ganged cell turned 90/270 so the keyways face out (its lamps 8.3 mm apart against the jacks' 11), cages std/sfp@1 on their side, left 270 and right 90. The reset hole is not visible against the dark plate in the image; it is drawn under its legend, where the large housing has it.

lamps.note: photo-measured - each jack has two lamps, green at its top and amber at its bottom, and the faceplate's colour key pairs green with LINK/ACT and red-orange with PoE; set per placement because the two columns are turned opposite ways.

power.note: datasheet - 'Power Supply DC 48-57 V'; 'Idling: 48V 1.96W / 55V 6.65W'; 'Full load: 48V 125.36W / 57V 122.15W'; 'PoE Budget 120W'. power-max-w takes the highest figure (125.36 W); no ambient is stated with any of them. The supply is not included ('the power supply is excluded from the package').

rear-layout.note: estimated - the back render is foreshortened top to bottom; widths are taken as fractions of the face on the same image row, heights as fractions of 110 mm and fitted to the face. An upper wall plate with its screws above the keyholes, the DIN clip, and a lower plate with its screws below, centred; the 42 mm plate (common/wall-plate-keyhole-2-42@1) because the large housing's 56 mm one would overrun the 44.5 mm flat. The DIN rail's centre line lies about 55 mm from the top of this face.

side-layout.note: estimated - from the three-quarter image: the sides are fins running front to back between the bevels, with a recessed channel and a raised badge plate carrying the wordmark on the right side. The left side is not photographed and is drawn as fins only.

silkscreen.note: photo-measured - legends transcribed from the AIS2001P front image: Reset, PWR, SYS, 5, 6; Fast Ring and SCP with leaders to switches 1 and 2; LINK/ACT and PoE under their colour keys; the port numbers, odd on the left; the SFP numbers on their gold strips; the summary line '4 x GE | 2 x GE SFP | PoE+' up the left. The AURCORE wordmark is printed as text: its A is drawn as a chevron mark, which is not reproduced (no logo marks).

sources.note: vendor datasheet (AIS2001P Data Sheet 1.0, 3 pages: spec table, and an annotated front and back figure that is the same artwork as the product images); the product page's three images (straight-on front, three-quarter front-top-right, and a back render raised to show the top face), 1000 px. No hardware guide or drawing is published, and the vendor video shows only the large housing.

top-layout.note: estimated - no straight-on top view exists. Positions are fractions of the top face in the back render (image 3), corrected with the parts' own sizes: the five-way power header runs front to back (its 35.56 mm reading 35 on the render) with its pole legend '1 + - earth + - 2' on one side and POWER:48-57V DC on the other, pole 1 at the rear; the RELAY header behind it; the CONSOLE jack behind that, a bare RJ45 with its keyway toward the front - the console is on the top face of the small housing, where the large one has it on the front; the ground screw and its earth symbol at the front edge. Good to a few millimetres.
